title: Work Journal header: a Today button, and the other page actions in a menu right of the date
story: The journal header now shows just the day arrows, the title and a Today button that brings you back to today. The rarer page actions (Jump to date, New page for a date, Delete page, Report, Pop out) moved into a small three-dot menu next to the title, which opens inside the journal and works fully from the keyboard. The pop-out window has the same header without Pop out.

checks.criterion: Today jumps to today's page from any other date
checks.steps: Open the Work Journal, press Previous day twice, then Today. Then press Next day three times, then Today.
checks.expected: Both times the title shows today's date.

checks.criterion: Every action that left the header works from the menu
checks.steps: Open the Work Journal in the side pane, made as narrow as it goes, and click the three-dot button right of the title. Click each action in turn. Repeat in the pop-out window.
checks.expected: The menu opens inside the pane with Jump to date, New page for a date, Delete page, Report and Pop out shown in full; each opens its date row, the delete question, the report dialog or the separate window. In the pop-out window the menu fits and has no Pop out.

checks.criterion: The same actions work by keyboard
checks.steps: Tab to the three-dot button and press Down. Press Down to reach Report and press Enter. Open the menu again, choose Jump to date with Enter and type 2026-10-01. Open it again and press Esc.
checks.expected: The first action is highlighted on open; Report opens the report dialog; the cursor is already in the date field for Jump to date; Esc closes the menu and returns focus to the button.
